lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 6 distinct high-contrast white vertical lines traverse the torso. Spacing is relatively uniform in the mid-section, becoming more compressed toward the posterior flank.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The most anterior line is abbreviated, terminating in the upper third of the torso. The two most posterior lines terminate before the ventral boundary of the torso mass.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Two isolated white circular spots are visible on the upper hindquarter/haunch area, positioned vertically relative to each other.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: The horns follow a spiral lyrate trajectory, diverging outward from the pedicles before curving medially and anteriorly at the tips.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The pixel distance between the terminal horn tips is approximately 1.5 times the width of the combined horn bases at the skull.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: The high-contrast ivory-colored tips constitute approximately 10-15% of the total vertical length of the horn structure.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a white transverse chevron across the muzzle; two distinct white spots on the lower cheek area; dorsal fringe of long white hair extending from the neck to the base of the tail; orange-tan coloration on the lower limbs distal to the knee/hock.
